beats.en: Animals on land and birds in the sky have different features that help them live. An elephant has a long trunk to take food and water, and a sparrow has a short strong beak to crack seeds.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 evs · Nature Trail · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: A bird with a long tail and a large curved beak was a hornbill, named for the horn-like headgear on its forehead. Peacocks are colourful, and owls have sharp eyesight to see at night.

beats.en: Animals that live in and around water have special features to survive. Fish have fins to swim, crabs walk, frogs jump and turtles swim.
